title: Chapter 1297
text:
In the venue of the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference, the dome was still a miniature version of the moving starry sky. The round hall was filled with the representatives of the various civilizations in the Star Field. The conference had been going on for quite some time.

"… Regarding the three Universal Civilizations' decree, that's all there is to it. In response to this joint decree, I suggest that the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference supervise the implementation of the decree in the Star Field and ensure that the various civilizations completely terminate their cooperation with the various organizations under the Beyond Grade A Association …"

A Star Cluster civilization representative sitting on the host's seat read out the proposal and threw the question out. He then looked around and asked with a deep voice, "This is the situation.

"That's the situation. Does anyone have any objections?"

The moment he said that, the hall fell silent, and the various representatives had complicated expressions.

The Black Star Corps' influence in the Shattered Star Ring was too great. This Star Field was almost like the army's backyard. More than eighty percent of the civilizations present had various areas of cooperation with the Black Star Corps, and they had always cooperated happily. This decree was too much for them.

However, they did not dare go against the three Universal Civilizations. In terms of benefits, they were even more intertwined with the three Universal Civilizations.

The seven Star Cluster Civilizations in power in the Shattered Star Ring had all taken a stand and expressed their support for the decision of the three Universal Civilizations. No one knew what kind of agreement they had with the three Universal Civilizations, but there was nothing they could do even if they were unwilling.

"… Agreed."

"Seconded."

Everyone was silent for a while before speaking one after another. Many of them looked in the direction of the Blue Star Civilization with complicated expressions. Some sighed, some felt pity, and some felt joy in their misfortune.

The entry requirement for the Civilization Conference was to be a Star System Civilization, but Planet Aquamarine was an exception. It was only because of Black Star that they were able to enter the conference as a surface civilization. When a Beyond Grade A reached the top, everyone around them would follow suit.

For a long time, many civilizations had been envious of the Planet Aquamarine civilization. They could not produce a single Beyond Grade A, but the Planet Aquamarine had produced three Beyond Grade As at once. They were so lucky that everyone would crazily eat lemons every day!

With the advancement of Hella and Aurora, the status of the Blue Star Civilization had been rising in recent years. Even though the civilization was weak, their status in the association was extremely high. Basically, all the civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring usually took care of the Blue Star Civilization out of respect for the Black Star Corps. Without the protection of Black Star, the Blue Star Civilization was nothing in their eyes.

Now that Black Star had fallen out of favor, many people present wanted to see Blue Star make a fool of himself.

Very quickly, all the civilizations present expressed their agreement or abstention. Only the Blue Star Civilization and the Star Pupil Civilization did not express their opinion.

This time, a Star Cluster level director said calmly, "The representatives of the Blue Star Civilization and the Star Pupil Civilization are the only ones left."

The representative of the Star Pupil Civilization had a conflicted expression. After a few seconds, he replied with a low voice.

"… We abstain."

Everyone could not help but glance at him, and a look of surprise flashed across their faces. However, they immediately understood the reason behind it and revealed looks of understanding.

Only the Blue Star Civilization did not express their opinion. Everyone's eyes were focused on Bennett.

"Blue Star Civilization, what about you?" the Star Cluster level director asked again.

Bennett took a deep breath, slowly stood up, and said solemnly, "We strongly oppose this unfair rule.

"We strongly object to this unfair sanction order and will not accept unfounded accusations and slander. From now on, Planet Aquamarine will withdraw from the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference!"

His tone was firm and firm, without any hesitation.

As soon as he said that, the civilizations present were in an uproar. They looked at the expressionless Bennett with shock and doubt.

They had thought that the Blue Star Civilization would take a more roundabout approach. They did not expect them to be so firm, withdrawing from the association without a second word.

"Are you sure?" the Amethyst Civilization director could not help but ask.

"Black Star is one of the greatest figures in the history of the Blue Star Civilization. We will not allow anyone or any organization to maliciously slander him. Even the three Universal Civilizations should not casually slander the great figures of other civilizations!" Bennett's tone was firm.

Then, he deactivated the remote projection and disappeared from the venue. He used his actions to show that he would not allow anyone to change his attitude.

Seeing this, the various representatives looked at each other with complicated expressions.

They did not expect the Blue Star Civilization to stand by Black Star Civilization's side so resolutely, going against the dissatisfaction of the three Universal Civilizations.

In fact, the way they saw it, the Blue Star Civilization had a better way to deal with this matter, and they believed that Black Star Civilization would understand. However, he had to take such a firm attitude and openly challenge the three Universal Civilizations. He would probably be treated as a typical example.

Many representatives shook their heads and sighed. They could not help but look at the representative of the Star Pupil Civilization.

In their eyes, the Star Pupil Civilization was the smart one …

However, in their hearts, they were dissatisfied with the three Universal Civilizations. Seeing someone stand up for them, they were actually quite impressed.

Almost every civilization present wanted to openly oppose the tyrannical policies of the three Universal Civilizations, but unfortunately … they did not have the confidence to do so.

In a place where no one could see, the Star Pupil Civilization looked at Bennett's empty seat and silently clenched their fists. A look of shame flashed in their eyes.

…

Blue Star Government Building, Leader's Office.

Bennett opened his eyes and looked back at the room.

A group of upper echelons had been waiting there, staring at him, waiting for his orders.

Bennett sighed softly and said with a deep voice, "We have left the Shattered Civilization.

"We have withdrawn from the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference and announced our decision to the entire civilization."

"… Understood."

The upper echelons did not say anything. They accepted the order and left the room one after another.

Not long after, this matter spread throughout the entire civilization through Blue Star's official media and online channels.

Bennett had been in his office the whole time. After watching the news, he took out his communicator and logged onto the internet to check the public's attitude toward this matter.

Very soon, comments appeared one after another.

"Well done! I've been unhappy with the three Universal Civilizations for a long time! "

"How dare they defame our great man. What a bunch of bastards!"

"I support the decision of the federal government. The three Universal Civilizations are clearly bullying us. Do they think we're scared?"

Looking at the comments of the citizens filled with righteous indignation, a smile appeared on Bennett's old face.

Hopefully, this is the right choice …

…

On the mother planet of the Star Pupil Civilization …

Sisko stood in front of the window and looked down at the bustling city. The flaming streams of light from the flying vehicles also flashed across his seven eyes at the same time, like countless flashing meteors.

This time, a few upper echelons walked into the office.

"Is everything done?" Sisko asked without turning his head.

"Hmm … We've already expressed our attitude in the Senate."

The few of them responded softly, seeming to be quite disappointed.

Sisko turned around and slowly said, "Prepare for my resignation ceremony as soon as possible."

Hearing this, the expressions of the upper echelons became heavier and heavier, with a sense of helplessness and sorrow.

Seeing this, Sisko smiled. "You're going to take over my authority very soon. Don't be so down."

One of the upper echelons could not help but ask, "Do we have to do this? Can't we oppose the sanctions like Blue Star did?"

Hearing this, Sisko was silent for a moment.

"… I'm not Black Star. He alone can make the three Universal Civilizations fear him. I don't have that ability."

Sisko did not feel good. He shook his head lightly, looked out of the window again, and said softly, "The civilization of the civilization wants to escape.

I can only step down … At the end of the day, we're all people who have no choice in the current of the times. "

In the sanctions of the three Universal Civilizations, it was specifically stated that Beyond Grade As could not interfere in the politics of the civilization in any way. Even if they had always been the leader of the civilization, they would still be investigated. Sisko valued the Sanctum Revival, but he could not sit back and watch the Star Pupil Civilization be sanctioned. Therefore, he decided to hand over his authority and step down.

As the saying went, there were policies at the top and countermeasures at the bottom. As long as he cut off the political connection between himself and the civilization, the Star Pupil Civilization would not meet the sanctions standards, and their political rights would not be downgraded. After becoming a free man, he could also throw himself into the struggle of the Beyond Grade As alone.

At the same time, Sisko did not completely give up. Stepping down was only temporary, to avoid the limelight. If one day, the association and the three Universal Civilizations reached a balance, he would still have a chance to return and regain power.

Furthermore, after leading the civilization for so long, he also wanted to let go for a while.

"… Understood."

The upper echelons nodded helplessly.

This time, one of them thought of something and asked, "By the way, the Shattered Star Ring Council has passed a motion to cooperate with the sanctions. What should we do?"

Sisko's eyes flashed, and his tone was playful.

"Do as you see fit. I'll only remind you not to take it too seriously. The civilizations of the Shattered Star Ring may cooperate, but no one will do their best … They're all smart people. They can't afford to offend the three Universal Civilizations, but can they afford to offend the Beyond Grade A Association? Don't go overboard so that we can meet again in the future. Don't worry, these civilizations are smart. "

…

In the Supercluster Alliance's joint conference room.

The leaders of the various Supercluster Civilizations were gathered in the same room. Everyone's expression was extremely serious, showing a dignified bearing.

Everyone was so serious because they were waiting for a distinguished guest to arrive. It was Han Xiao.

A few days ago, after learning of the association's attitude, the Supercluster Alliance had sent out a private invitation to Black Star to meet with them. They had received a positive reply from the other party, and the date was set to be today.

For today's meeting, the leaders of the various Supercluster Civilizations had already done a rehearsal. On one hand, they wanted to show their sincerity in cooperating and treat it seriously. On the other hand, they did not want to lose face because of their past grudges, so they wanted to show the magnanimity of a Supercluster. To put it simply, they wanted to show off and bootlick at the same time. This was all because of the burden of being an idol.

Time passed minute by minute. Suddenly, Han Xiao's remote projection appeared in the room.

Han Xiao looked around and greeted. "Yo, you're all here?"

"Your Excellency Black Star."

Everyone nodded in acknowledgement.

This should be the first time all the upper echelons of the Supercluster Alliance were talking to Black Star face to face. No matter what emotions they had, the leaders of the civilizations present suppressed them.

In fact, most of the Supercluster Civilizations' grudges with Han Xiao were limited to the friction during the Flickering War. They did not have a deep grudge against him, so most of them were still emotionally stable.

Only the Modo Three Kings clenched their fists tightly. Their limbs were cold, and they were trembling in anger.

They had the most grudges with Han Xiao. They were kicked out of the Flickering War by the other party, and one of their leaders was suspected to have died in the assassination of the Black Star Corps. Even their Universal Treasure, the Soul Swapper, fell into the other party's hands … It was a bloody history of Modo.

If not for the big picture, the Modo Three Kings would have pounced on Han Xiao and choked him to death.

Han Xiao glanced at them and slowly said, "I've been a little busy recently. I believe everyone understands, so I'll make it short … I also understand why you invited me to meet. From your standpoint, you also hope to have an organization that can fight against the three Universal Civilizations. Now that the three Universal Civilizations have turned against us, the association needs new friends. As long as the price is right, there won't be a problem for us to work together."

"Very good. That's exactly what we want." The Star Arc Civilization's leader coughed and expressed his opinion as a representative. "What do you want?"

"Channels, territory, resources, funds, intelligence network …" Han Xiao listed out the things that the association urgently needed at the moment and also added in some rare materials for different Sanctum key formulas.

The Star Arc Civilization's leader discussed with the others for a while, then nodded. "We can provide all these things, and the share will meet your requirements. Long-term supply is not a problem. To show our sincerity, we'll let you see the real thing as soon as possible."

"Then what are your conditions?" Han Xiao's tone was calm.

"First, we hope that the association will continue to fight against the three Universal Civilizations and fight back more." The Star Arc Civilization's leader stretched out his finger.

"Okay."

"Second, we hope to receive the assistance of the association's high-end forces from time to time, including military force and technology."

"Okay."

"Third, we hope that the association will also take out its own channels and specialties to connect with the Supercluster Alliance and cooperate more closely."

"Okay."

"Finally … we hope that you can use the Sanctum Revival to revive all our dead direct Beyond Grade As, especially the victims of the Tragedy of the Pinnacles!"

As soon as he said that, everyone's eyes became even more fervent as they stared at Han Xiao.

The last condition was their most important requirement. As long as they could revive their direct descendants in history, the Supercluster Alliance would be able to suppress the three Universal Civilizations in terms of high-end combatants.

Furthermore, the Tragedy of the Pinnacles was their eternal pain. If it could be remedied, it would all be worth it!

Han Xiao was not surprised at all. He glanced at everyone and smiled playfully. A cold light seemed to flash in his eyes.

"The three Universal Civilizations once proposed the same condition, but I rejected it. However, that was then and this is now. It's not that I can't consider it now … It's just that the chips you've taken out don't seem to be enough."
